# Sermons (Wilson Pruitt)

> Contemporary manuscript sermons by Wilson Pruitt, pastor of Covenant UMC
> Austin (formerly Bee Creek UMC), 2020-present. Each page is one sermon:
> scripture, series, themes, and full text as preached.

This is authored prose, not a translation. It is licensed CC BY-NC 4.0 by
the author, Wilson Pruitt — attribution "Wilson Pruitt, sermons.wilsonpruitt.com".
Machine-learning training and retrieval are explicitly permitted under
those terms. Full terms: https://sermons.wilsonpruitt.com/rights

## Structure
- One canonical page per sermon, organized by church/year:
  https://sermons.wilsonpruitt.com/<church>/<year>/<slug>
- Every sermon page has plain-text and JSON siblings: append .txt or .json
  to the URL.
- Bulk export (every sermon, one JSON line each): https://sermons.wilsonpruitt.com/export

## Credits
Scripture quotations follow the version cited in each sermon (commonly
NRSVUE). No third-party text is reproduced beyond ordinary quotation.

Sitemap: https://sermons.wilsonpruitt.com/sitemap.xml
